---
title: "Data & Methodology"
subtitle: "Indicator definitions, cleaning decisions, and replicability"
---

## Original data

The file `data/WDI_Raw.xlsx` is the provided World Bank WDI export, with a `Data` worksheet and a `Series - Metadata` worksheet. The analysis uses the 2019 entries for these exact indicators:

| WDI series code | Original definition | Name in R |
|---|---|---|
| `NY.GDP.MKTP.KD` | GDP (constant 2015 US$) | `gdp_constant_2015_usd` |
| `NE.IMP.GNFS.ZS` | Imports of goods and services (% of GDP) | `imports_pct_gdp` |
| `NY.GDP.DEFL.KD.ZG` | Inflation, GDP deflator (annual %) | `inflation_gdp_deflator_pct` |
| `NE.EXP.GNFS.ZS` | Exports of goods and services (% of GDP) | `exports_pct_gdp` |

**Important:** The first indicator is aggregate GDP, not GDP per capita. The inflation rate is the *GDP-deflator* measure, not necessarily consumer-price inflation.

## Cleaning and computation

1. Read the original Excel file without modifying it.
2. Convert four economic indicators to numeric; mark unavailable entries as missing.
3. Remove World Bank regional/income aggregates using ISO3 country-code recognition.
4. Restrict to complete observations for all four variables.
5. Check that the United States appears exactly once.
6. Compute descriptive statistics and the correlation matrix.
7. Compute covariance-adjusted Mahalanobis distances between every country and the USA; rank **other countries only**.

The script `R_analysis.R` implements these steps. The exact retained sample may differ from the older Stata study depending on aggregate exclusions and missing data; see the generated overview instead of assuming the originally reported sample size.

## Replication

Install R and [Quarto](https://quarto.org/), open the project directory, and run:

```bash
Rscript -e 'install.packages(c("readxl","dplyr","ggplot2","countrycode","knitr"), repos="https://cloud.r-project.org")'
quarto render
quarto preview
```

The generated website is in `_site/`. Quarto can publish it using GitHub Pages from a **public** repository (or through another free compatible host). Do not upload private datasets or sensitive material to a public repository.

## Provenance

This is a Quarto/R reanalysis of the original empirical class project by **Chipo Jaya and Xianghan Zhu**, adapted as an ISS Data Analytics Project. The original report is reference material, not a source of hard-coded results. All tables and charts in the main page are computed from the included WDI workbook at render time.
